author: Alan Johnson
title: 'Life-changing' ingredient to add to oatmeal in the morning - NewsBreak
text: Jelly and honey might be the go-to choices to add flavor to oatmeal, but one woman has introduced a novel twist that promises to elevate your breakfast – and it won't cost too much. Carla, who shares budget food advice on TikTok , shared her inventive suggestion in a new video. Clutching a box of Yorkshire Tea, a popular brand of English breakfast tea in the UK, the Brit said: "If you love tea and you've not tried putting your tea bag in your oatmeal, you really must try it." Carla said her preferred choice is Yorkshire Tea's caramelized biscuit [cookie] tea bags. "These are my ultimate favorite, but you can use any tea bag," she added. To make the breakfast, combine oatmeal oats, a tea bag, sweetener, and water in a bowl and "allow the tea bag to brew." READ MORE: Simple test shows if soy sauce is high quality – without opening or tasting it READ MORE: Tourist orders two drinks at Las Vegas hotspot and price leaves them floored She continued: "You then just microwave this for two to three minutes and the tea will kind of exude itself into your oatmeal." After heating, Carla added a sprinkle of chopped strawberries and whey powder for added protein, recommending a plain flavor so as to not affect the taste of the tea, and topped it off with soy crispies and pistachios. She admitted: "Obviously the gross bit is removing the tea bag. "I really recommend this though – it's like a way of getting a double-dose of caffeine in the morning. I'm imagining coffee lovers could do the same thing with coffee in their oatmeal, but think of all the possibilities here. "Has anyone tried peppermint tea oatmeal?" she concluded. "Would that work? Is that a different vibe? Green tea oatmeal perhaps?". The video has garnered more than 200,000 viewers in just four days, with TikTok users keen to share their thoughts on her idea. One said: "Tea-infused porridge [oatmeal]? Brilliant idea! How about trying a matcha porridge next?" A second person suggested: "I love these tea bags so will try this! I recommend the Tesco vanilla chai ones too," in reference to a tea flavour available at a popular UK supermarket chain. To this, Carla replied: "I've never tried chai and would be nervous to waste a whole box. I need to find someone who has it and 'borrow' it!" A third added: "Coffee porridge is so underrated, add instant coffee to the oats and it's 10/10." A fourth exclaimed: "This may be life changing information." Whilst a fifth shared: "I had some Earl Grey porridge in a hotel in Canada and it's one of my favourite meals ever so this is right up my street." And a TikToker chimed in with their method: "I like really strong tea so I usually just rip up the teabag and put the tea leaves straight in my oats." That prompted Carla to counter: "Interesting!
